newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P affirms Trygg-Hansa A+ credit rating.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Trygg-Hansa A+ credit rating.

text.p: U.S. credit ratings agency Standard & Poor's on Wednesday affirmed its single A+ claims-paying ability rating of Swedish insurer Trygg-Hansa Insurance Co., Ltd.

"The affirmation reflects superior consolidated group capitalisation, a strong business position in Swedish personal and commercial lines, an efficient new management team that has successfully tackled past strategic problems, as well as sound investments and an improved operating performance," S&P said in a statement.

"Partially offsetting these strengths, S&P believes that the fierce competition in Sweden amongst a steadily consolidating sector remains a threat to Trygg-Hansa Insurance's business position and could place pressure on margins across the sector."
Further cost savings will be paramount if the group wishes to maintain its existing position in the life and non-life markets within a rapidly consolidating environment, S&P said.
"In that respect, the still open offer to merge with Wasa, a large Swedish mutual player, has evident attractions, even though a successful conclusion at present appears unlikely," S&P said.
Trygg-Hansa Insurance has approached Wasa, but Wasa has turned the offer down.
Given the mature and competitive nature of the Swedish non-life market, S&P sees at best a slow increase in premium income, the agency said.
"The life and savings areas, however, will continue to boost consolidated revenues," the agency said.
Capital will remain excellent on a risk-based basis, despite an expected decline, and operating results should remain good as management continues to stress cost control, S&P said.

"Longer term, however, the company may have to pursue a strategic alliance with another Nordic player for cost and distribution reasons, if competition within the insurance and the banking sectors remains intense," the agency said.
